content.text: The stats API caps a query at 7 days, so I'll pull the flight in two windows and add them together.

The campaign ran as planned from Wed Nov 25 through Wed Dec 2 (Eastern), and it stayed under the 750 USD budget. Stats were pulled after the flight ended. I can't send email from here, so the recap is below for you to forward.

**Recap: The Lantern in the Snow contest, X campaign**

- **Spend:** 697.56 USD of the 750.00 USD budget
- **Impressions:** 573,217
- **Link clicks:** 192
- **Contest entries ("Drawing entered" pixel):** 22, about 31.71 USD per entry

By ad group:

| Ad group | Post | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link clicks | Entries |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Woodland lantern | 2123642491501722570 | 329.86 | 257,539 | 77 | 10 |
| B: Christmas gift | 2123823685434688529 | 37.93 | 26,680 | 11 | 0 |
| C: Rules and eligibility | 2124004879365323099 | 329.77 | 288,998 | 104 | 12 |

Notes:
- Of the 22 entries, 14 were attributed to a click and 8 to a view. The pixel reports both kinds, so the entry count includes view-through conversions.
- Targeting was United States and Canada, aged 21+, using X's AGE_OVER_21 criterion. That criterion is the closest X offers to a 21+ cutoff, so it's worth confirming it matches your submission policy.

What I did:
- **Post 2124186073300227528 was not promoted.** Its copy doesn't mention the contest or entering, so it would have spent money on clicks that don't lead to entries.
- **Ad group B was paused on Nov 26.** After about 33 hours it had 37 USD of spend and no entries, so I moved its share of the budget to A and C.
- **Ad groups A and C were raised to 46 USD/day** to use the remaining budget. Their total caps were set to 330 USD each, and B's to 40 USD, for 700 USD combined.
- **The campaign and ad groups have ended** because each had an end time set. I didn't pause them manually.

If you'd like to run this again, the one thing I'd change is spend. Ad group B didn't convert at all, so a future flight would likely do better with only the two posts that converted.
